notes.text: Appendix A describes a modified FDS-v2 nucleation/condensation calculation that explicitly excludes coagulation. The global DBP growth model couples vapor depletion, aerosol mass and droplet diameter, with Kelvin curvature, temperature-dependent vapor pressure/surface tension, and f(Kn)=(1+Kn)/(1+1.71Kn+1.333Kn²). Here Kn=2 lambda/Dp and lambda refers to condensing-vapor molecular transport, not automatically the air mean free path used in a Brownian kernel. Equations require DBP vapor mole fraction, total pressure, temperature history, liquid density, molecular volume and diffusion coefficient. The report models condensation becoming negligible within 30 cm; Appendix B interprets ground results as mainly coagulation by roughly 20 cm. These are configuration-specific estimates, not universal cutoff lengths. Property-correlation validity ranges and required transport histories still need verification before implementation. See the separately recovered diameter-growth equation note.

notes.text: The final report defines DA=M1/M0 and DM=(M3/M0)^(1/3), Dg=sqrt(DA³/DM), and sigma_g=exp(sqrt(ln(DM/DA))). Equivalent Dg=M0^(-4/3) M1^(3/2) M3^(-1/6). Positive moments and DM>=DA are necessary; inconsistent measured moments must be rejected or investigated, not forced into a distribution. These reconstruct an assumed lognormal distribution from calibrated moments; they are not direct bin-resolved size measurements. For independent moment errors, relative variance of Dg is (16/9)u_r(M0)²+(9/4)u_r(M1)²+(1/36)u_r(M3)². For sigma_g it is [u_r(M0)²+2.25u_r(M1)²+0.25u_r(M3)²]/[9 ln²(sigma_g)]. Shared dilution/calibration errors require covariance terms; the sigma_g approximation becomes singular near a monodisperse distribution. DustTrak red-light scattering at 90 degrees is described as approximately third-moment sensitive over 0.2–2 µm, with calibration corrections; do not confuse it with the ISS detector geometry.

notes.text: The atmosphere-dilution model assumes constant pressure, temperature and volume, with well-mixed outflow and nitrogen inflow balanced by leakage.
